name: clean-links-gmail
description: Write Gmail drafts from Claude with every link saved exactly as written. No broken Google redirect links.
long_description: Clean Links Gmail lets Claude create, edit, and send Gmail drafts while keeping every link exactly as written. It also repairs Google redirect links (google.com/url?q=...) back into the real address before anything is saved or sent, and refuses to save a draft if a redirect link cannot be repaired. It runs on your own computer with your own Google credentials. Your email travels only between your computer and Google.

tools.name: gmail_sign_in
tools.description: Connect to your Gmail by signing in to Google in your browser.

tools.name: gmail_connection_status
tools.description: Check which Gmail address is connected.

tools.name: create_draft

tools.name: create_reply_draft

tools.name: get_draft
tools.description: Read a draft back exactly as Gmail saved it, with a list of its links.

client_id.title: Google Client ID
client_id.description: From your own Google Cloud project (Desktop app credential). Ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com. See the guide on the GitHub page.

client_secret.title: Google Client Secret
client_secret.description: From the same Google Cloud credential. Stored in your computer's secure keychain.
